acceptanceCriteria: A1: Failed lifecycle gates persist a blocked Outcome with failedGate and recoveryCondition while preserving active state
A2: Recovery events are strict repository and Work Item bound append-only records and cannot be duplicated or forged
A3: A later valid finish may append completion after a blocked event without rewriting prior history
A4: Malformed foreign or symlinked failure records fail closed and never become success
A5: CLI and MCP expose the same blocked Outcome facts and tri-language human rendering
goal: Make failed finish and downstream lifecycle gates visible, identity-bound, and recoverable for humans and Agents.
intent: Persist fail-closed lifecycle failure outcomes and append-only recovery events without claiming completion.
